components.css: .ds-discovery { display: flex; flex-direction: column; min-width: 0; min-height: 212px; height: 100%; padding: 24px 22px 16px; border: 1px solid var(--border, #2C2C35); border-radius: 12px; background: var(--surface, #141418); font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; transition: border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-discovery:hover { border-color: #52505f; } .ds-discovery.ds-is-saved { border-color: #756596; } .ds-discovery-name { margin: 0 0 12px; color: var(--text, #F2F2F5); font: 500 34px/1.2 'Space Grotesk', sans-serif; letter-spacing: -.025em; overflow-wrap: anywhere; user-select: text; } .ds-discovery-hint { display: -webkit-box; -webkit-box-orient: vertical; -webkit-line-clamp: 1; overflow: hidden; min-height: 22px; margin: 0 0 24px; color: var(--muted, #A1A1AE); font-size: 14px; line-height: 22px; } .ds-discovery-actions { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 4px; margin: auto -6px 0; } .ds-discovery-actions button { display: inline-flex; min-height: 44px; padding: 8px 7px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; background: none; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; color: var(--muted, #A1A1AE); font: 400 14px 'Inter', sans-serif; cursor: pointer; } .ds-discovery-actions button:hover { background: var(--surface-2, #1C1C22); color: var(--text, #F2F2F5); } .ds-discovery-actions .ds-save { color: var(--text, #F2F2F5); } .ds-discovery-actions .ds-save[aria-pressed='true'] { color: #c8baff; } .ds-discovery-actions button:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #BAADFF; outline-offset: 4px; } .ds-discovery-actions svg { width: 16px; height: 16px; flex-shrink: 0; } @media (max-width: 699px) { .ds-discovery-name { font-size: 32px; } .ds-discovery { min-height: 198px; padding: 22px 20px 14px; } } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { *, *::before, *::after { animation: none !important; scroll-behavior: auto !important; transition-duration: 0s !important; } }

narrative.overview:
This is a descriptive label for the user-approved existing system, not a new metaphor. A near-black ground, slightly lighter surfaces, restrained violet, and generous spacing keep names easy to read. Space Grotesk gives names and headings a clear identity; Inter carries the interface.

The system recorded here covers the current application header, Create discovery, Saved names, Details drawer, and Compare dialog. English interface copy and the existing local fonts are binding choices. Names remain selectable text, and the hierarchy places each name before its construction hint and actions.
keyCharacteristics: Dark tonal surfaces with fine borders.
Large names with readable, explicitly labelled actions.
A centered, spacious frame that adapts from three columns to one.
Flat cards, with shadows reserved for overlapping panels.
Visible keyboard focus and reduced-motion support.

rules.name: The Color Role Rule
rules.body: Use violet for primary actions and the implemented selected states. Use neutral text and surfaces for the main reading hierarchy.

rules.name: The Readable Names Rule
rules.body: Keep discovery names at the implemented desktop and mobile sizes, keep action labels at least 14px, and allow long names to wrap.

rules.name: The Flat Cards Rule
rules.body: Keep discovery cards flat at rest and on hover. Reserve shadows for the implemented popovers and dialogs.

dos: Do preserve the approved dark palette, English interface, Inter, and Space Grotesk.
Do keep names visually dominant, selectable, and able to wrap.
Do preserve the 1160px frame and the three/two/one-column transitions at 1100px and 700px.
Do keep core action labels at least 14px and their targets at least 44px.
Do preserve visible focus, native dialog behavior, and the reduced-motion override.
Do retain visible labels and explanations alongside state colors and icons.
donts: Don't promote legacy Lab, AI Studio, landing, or Settings styling into the core system without a separate review.
Don't reuse emoji or text glyphs as control icons where the current system uses drawn SVGs.
Don't turn structural scores or snapshot-check colors into a visual quality or availability guarantee.
Don't add elevation or entrance animation to the discovery-card pattern.
Don't shrink names or widen the document to fit the mobile comparison table.
